title: Legionnaires 3 #4 DC May 1986 Final Issue Time Trapper Giffen Ernie Colon Legion
condition_description: Cover clean with no creases or tears; light toning on the cream cover and back. Spine and staples intact. See photos.
description:
Legionnaires 3 #4 of 4 (May 1986), DC Comics - final issue of the mini-series. "Okay, Time Trapper -- You Win!" - Cosmic Boy cover. Plot by Keith Giffen, script by Mindy Newell, pencils by Ernie Colon, cover by Ernie Colon and Karl Kesel. 75c cover price.

Back cover: Monogram Lightning radio-controlled racer ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
